page_title: NAN 0-1 REI | Nantes v Reims 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Moses Simon (Nantes) is about to take a free kick near the halfway line.
90+5' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+4' Kader Bamba (Nantes) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
90+2' The Nantes players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the corner which is cleared.
88' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
88' A substitution has been made. Junya Ito is replaced by Amadou Kone (Reims).
86' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

85' Maxime Busi (Reims) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
84' Here is a change. Quentin Merlin is going off and Pierre Aristouy gives the last tactical orders to Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes).
84' The referee signals a substitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Eray Comert.
83' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
83' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Moses Simon (Nantes) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

81' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Yehvann Diouf thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
80' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) coming on for Marcus Coco.
77' The game has come to an end for Adson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ignatius Ganago (Nantes).
75' 0 - 1 Mohamed Daramy feeds the ball through to Junya Ito (Reims), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
73' William Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thibault De Smet (Reims) replacing Josh Wilson-Esbrand.
73' A substitution has been made. Azor Matusiwa goes off and Mohamed Daramy (Reims) comes on.
71' Maxime Busi (Reims) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
66' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Oumar Diakite (Reims) is replacing Amine Salama.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matthis Abline (Nantes) will replace Mostafa Mohamed.
66' William Still has decided to make a change. Maxime Busi (Reims) replaces Thomas Foket.
64' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
64' What a huge chance for Junya Ito (Reims). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
63' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
59' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
57' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Gael Angoula blows his whistle as Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
56' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Yehvann Diouf has no trouble gathering it.
53' What was Thomas Foket (Reims) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
51' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' Amine Salama receives a sweet pass inside the box from Junya Ito (Reims), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
47' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nantes for a penalty. Play continues.
46' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
46' Referee Gael Angoula blows his whistle to start the second half.
45' The first half of today's match has just finished.
44' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
44' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.
43' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but it's cleared.
41' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
40' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Nantes.
37' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
35' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
32' Junya Ito (Reims) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
32' A perfect long pass by Teddy Teuma (Reims) finds Josh Wilson-Esbrand. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
31' Junya Ito (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' The Reims players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Joseph Okumu (Reims) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
22' Referee Gael Angoula sees the trip by Thomas Foket (Reims) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
21' A crossfield pass from Marcus Coco (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
19' A precise short pass from Samuel Moutoussamy releases Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
18' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Yehvann Diouf, who makes a comfortable save.
17' Moses Simon (Nantes) works the corner short.
16' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
15' Close! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Reims was in an offside position.
10' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
9' Alban Lafont (Nantes) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
6' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
3' Nantes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
1' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Alban Lafont comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Teddy Teuma (Reims) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Gael Angoula has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
Reims will kick-off.
Gael Angoula will officiate today.
